cases.name: Katlynn Marie Jones
cases.about:
Her neighbor describes her as a beautiful person inside and out. “She was an angel, she was a young girl that hadn’t had a chance to even have her life yet,” said Lisa McCleary.

Her obituary said, "She attended Cosmetology school and loved making others feel beautiful when doing their hair and makeup. Katlynn was full of life, she was always the life of the party, and never met a stranger. She loved to dance, hunt, sing, and ride four wheelers. She loved spending time with her son Mason, who was the spotlight of her world. She was a loving mother, daughter, sister, and friend."
